```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)

# Replace with your sheet ID (the long string in your Google Sheet URL)
#Sys.setenv(cv_sheet_id = "1vqpnOiayNJtWZyUBLJ2CdViibK-q8M38y-mgLZ2R_OE")
#cv_sheet_id <- Sys.getenv("cv_sheet_id")
cv_sheet_id <- "1vqpnOiayNJtWZyUBLJ2CdViibK-q8M38y-mgLZ2R_OE"

# Use gs4_deauth() if your sheet is publicly shared (view access for anyone with link)
# Use gs4_auth() if your sheet is private (will prompt login during quarto render)
gs4_deauth()

pubs <- read_sheet(cv_sheet_id, sheet = "publications")

published   <- pubs %>% filter(status == "published")   %>% arrange(desc(year))
submitted   <- pubs %>% filter(status == "submitted")   %>% arrange(desc(year))
in_progress <- pubs %>% filter(status == "in_progress") %>% arrange(desc(year))

# Build one card per publication
make_card <- function(row, coauthor_label = FALSE) {
  
  # Title + card link — use first URL from details if present
  url <- if (!is.na(row$link) && row$link != "") row$link else NULL
  title_html <- paste0('<span class="pub-title">', row$title, '</span>')
  
  # Authors — bold "Kelling" wherever it appears
  authors_raw  <- gsub("Kelling, C.", "<strong>Kelling, C.</strong>", 
                       row$authors %||% row$coauthors %||% "")
  authors_html <- if (coauthor_label) paste0("<b>Coauthors:</b> ", 
                                             authors_raw) else authors_raw
  
  # Venue + year
  venue_year <- ""
  if (!is.na(row$venue) && row$venue != "") {
    venue_year <- paste0('<span class="pub-venue">', row$venue, '</span>')
    if (!is.na(row$year)) {
      venue_year <- paste0(venue_year, '<span class="pub-year">, ', row$year, '</span>')
    }
  }
  
  # Thumbnail — looks for file in files/pub-images/; skipped if missing
  has_image <- !is.na(row$image) && row$image != ""
  img_html <- if (has_image) {
    paste0('<div class="pub-img"><img src="files/pub-images/', row$image, '" alt="', row$title, '"></div>')
  } else {
    '<div class="pub-img pub-img-placeholder"></div>'
  }

  card_inner <- paste0(
    img_html,
    '<div class="pub-content">',
      '<div class="pub-title-line">', title_html, '</div>',
      '<div class="pub-authors">', authors_html, '</div>',
      '<div class="pub-meta">', venue_year, '</div>',
    '</div>'
  )

  if (!is.null(url)) {
    paste0('<a href="', url, '" target="_blank" class="pub-card">', card_inner, '</a>')
  } else {
    paste0('<div class="pub-card">', card_inner, '</div>')
  }
}

# Null coalescing helper
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.na(a) && a != "") a else b

render_section <- function(df, coauthor_label = FALSE) {
  cards <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), 
                    function(i) make_card(df[i, ], coauthor_label), 
                    character(1))  
  paste0('<div class="pub-list">', paste(cards, collapse = "\n"), '</div>')
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

if (nrow(published) > 0) {
  #cat("## Published\n\n")
  cat(render_section(published))
  cat("\n\n")
}

```

```{css}
#| echo: false

.pub-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.pub-card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
  border-left: 4px solid #4a7fa5;
  border-radius: 6px;
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  background-color: #ffffff;
  transition: box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.pub-img {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 90px;
  height: 90px;
}

.pub-img img {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.pub-img-placeholder {
  background-color: #f0f0f0;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.pub-content {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.pub-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.pub-title-line {
  margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
}

.pub-title {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #222;
  text-decoration: none;
}

a.pub-title:hover {
  color: #4a7fa5;
  text-decoration: underline;
}

.pub-authors {
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  color: #444;
  margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
}

.pub-meta {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  color: #666;
}

.pub-venue {
  font-style: italic;
}

.pub-year {
  font-style: normal;
}
```
